name: Pixel Kingdom
interfaceDescription: Styles the whole site as a 16-bit role-playing world: meadow pages, parchment dialog boxes framed in oak and gold, and pixel lettering for headings and buttons.
publicProfileDescription: Turns your public profile into a 16-bit adventurer's sheet: castle-road banner, parchment panels and oak frames.
rationale: An original 16-bit adventure: a meadow world map under a dithered sky, a castle road and a village, parchment dialog boxes in oak frames with gold trim, and an original 5x7 pixel face for headings and buttons. Reading text keeps the site's body font. Every control in the Complete edition is redrawn on a 16-pixel grid with dark outlines and two-tone shading.

masterySemantics.unknown: A sealed treasure chest with a question mark: the concept is found but not yet opened.
masterySemantics.partial: A sword half drawn from its stone: progress made, the quest continues.
masterySemantics.clear: A sword raised with a green gem: the challenge has been understood.
masterySemantics.mastered: A golden crown with a shining star: the quest is complete.

contrastRecommendations.lightText: Use ink #3B2A1A on parchment #FBF1D6; forest green #2C6B41 for links.
contrastRecommendations.darkText: Use #FFFAF0 on dark oak #5B3A1E for menus and the header.
contrastRecommendations.secondary: Use #6B5440 for muted prose on parchment; gold is a trim, never small text.
contrastRecommendations.icons: Pixel icons carry a one-pixel dark outline, so they hold on parchment, meadow and oak alike.
